The '''Esh-kha savants''' was a caste of the [[Esh-kha]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that consisted of the species' [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]]. Savants had more prominent nostrils on the front of their faces, and lacked the ear-like protrusions that the mainline species possessed; instead, their heads were more triangular.
